versions.changelog:
YouTube Trending 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Fetches and displays top trending YouTube videos by country and/or category.
- Uses only Python 3 standard library (no pip dependencies).
- Requires a free YouTube Data API v3 key; setup instructions included for all platforms.
- Customizable output: choose country, number of results (up to 50), and video category.
- Clean output for each video with title, channel, views, likes, and direct link.
- Rate limits and API error handling explained for user guidance.
